title: quiet vs standard background
rule: Visible background for dense control arrays / isolated buttons; quiet (no fill) only when a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable. Too many quiet controls in a small space are hard to read.
pass_when: Standard (visible background) is used for dense arrays or isolated buttons; quiet is used only where a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable.
fail_when: Quiet (no fill) in a dense small space, or isolated buttons with no visible field background.
overview: Standard filled backgrounds for dense or isolated controls; quiet only in clear grids.
apply_when: Choosing quiet versus standard text-field chrome in dense forms or tables.
not_when: Isolated buttons or dense clusters that need a visible field background.
agent_hint: Use visible backgrounds for dense or isolated controls; quiet only in clear stacks.
description: Spectrum text fields use a visible background for dense control arrays and isolated buttons so each field stays parseable. Quiet (no fill) is reserved for places where a clear stack, table, or grid already makes the field boundaries obvious. Too many quiet controls in a small space become hard to read. Prefer standard chrome for crowded or lone controls; reserve quiet for structured layouts that already group the fields.
do_not_claim: Hit-target px floors; quiet as a brand default.
